desc: Ideation: reduce the alkane problem to finding the maximum connected set of original-degree-at-least-4 vertices with selected internal degree at most 4; answer is 3K+2.
Implement the O(N) iterative rooted DP described above and produce a complete Python program reading stdin and writing stdout.

Validate the implementation on the samples and edge cases: no eligible vertices, exactly one eligible vertex, ineligible vertices separating eligible components, and high-degree eligible vertices with many eligible branches.
